comment: teleport.c tele_jump_ok() 409: on the Plane of Air the up and down teleport regions exclude different areas, so a hero inside the up region's excluded area (x 25-79) cannot teleport out of it. A debug dwarven Archeologist puts on a ring of levitation and level-teleports to the Plane of Air (the debug menu supplies the Amulet; she declines its wish with 'nothing' and #wizkills the Wizard of Yendor who arrives beside her). A controlled ^T takes her to x 24, she floats one step east to x 25, and a second ^T (overriding the Amulet's disorientation) back to x 24 fails the updest test (409): 'Sorry...'.
